Hi Alex — great to hear from you and welcome. Short answers up front, full plan below:

- Best practice: split the CAIQ into the question-level responses in Vendr and attach supporting documents (SOC 2 report, diagrams) as individual artifacts. That makes future revalidation much easier.
- We can provide temporary pre-signed S3 URLs for uploads. We'll generate time-limited presign links for any file > 10MB; smaller files can be uploaded directly through the Vendr UI.

Plan / next steps:
1) I'll kick off a Vendr profile creation for BridgePay today and invite your security@ address.
2) Jonas — can you prepare a short presign-runbook we can share with BridgePay? Include maximum allowed size, TTL, and ACL policy (private).
3) Ben — please pre-fill the CAIQ template in Vendr (I'll share the seed answers from BridgePay's attached packet) and mark the SOC 2 report as "sensitive" so we can restrict visibility to reviewers only.

Alex — if that works I'll send the presign link instructions and the initial Vendr invite by EOD.

Thanks,

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-13T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: initial inventory + upload method question

Naomi / Ben — putting a draft presign runbook here (summary):

- Presign behavior: POST to /internal/presign with payload (filename, content-type, size). Returns single-use PUT URL valid 2 hours.
- Size limits: up to 250MB for single file; files >250MB require chunking (we can provide multipart presign).
- ACL: object stored private; Vendr catalog will reference a signed metadata pointer only.
- TTL: link valid 2 hours; after successful upload the object gets moved to a secure bucket with 30-day retention for onboarding artifacts.
- Security note: we will hash (sha256) uploaded files and store fingerprint in Vendr record to detect tampering.

Action items:
- Ben: update the onboarding checklist to flag any "sensitive" file types (SOC 2 PDF, audit logs).
- Naomi: share the example presign curl command with Alex; include guidance for corporations that upload from restricted networks (our presign supports x-amz-server-side-encryption header).

I'll drop the runbook into the Jira ticket and link here.

Jonas
Senior Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference
